sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.content:
Industrial Maintenance Technician with 7 years of hands-on experience maintaining
production machinery, conveyor systems, pumps, motors, pneumatic equipment, and basic
electrical control systems in manufacturing environments. Experienced in preventive
maintenance, equipment troubleshooting, breakdown response, machine installation, and
maintenance documentation. Familiar with factory safety procedures, 5S, lockout/tagout
practices, and working with production teams to reduce machine downtime.

sections.heading: Industrial Maintenance Technician
sections.content:
Siam Precision Components Co., Ltd.​
Bang Phli, Samut Prakan, Thailand​
March 2022 – Present
●​ Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production machinery, conveyor
systems, hydraulic units, pumps, motors, and pneumatic equipment.
●​ Diagnose mechanical and basic electrical faults during production breakdowns.
●​ Replace bearings, belts, chains, sensors, solenoid valves, cylinders, and other worn
machine components.
●​ Inspect equipment according to daily, weekly, and monthly preventive maintenance
schedules.
●​ Support machine installation, alignment, testing, and commissioning activities.
●​ Record maintenance activities, spare-parts usage, equipment faults, and completed
repairs.
●​ Coordinate with production supervisors during emergency machine shutdowns.
●​ Assist external contractors during major equipment servicing and facility
maintenance.
●​ Follow factory safety procedures, PPE requirements, 5S standards, and
lockout/tagout procedures.
Maintenance Mechanic
Eastern Packaging Industries Co., Ltd.​
Chon Buri, Thailand​
June 2019 – February 2022
●​ Maintained packaging machines, rollers, gearboxes, conveyors, air compressors,
and utility equipment.
●​ Responded to mechanical breakdowns and performed fault inspection before repair.
●​ Conducted lubrication, belt tension adjustment, bearing replacement, and equipment
cleaning.
●​ Assisted electricians with motor replacement, proximity sensor installation, and
control-panel inspection.
●​ Performed basic welding and fabrication for machine guards, brackets, frames, and
repair work.
●​ Prepared tools and replacement parts for scheduled maintenance.
●​ Reported recurring equipment problems to the maintenance supervisor.
Junior Maintenance Technician
Metro Food Processing Co., Ltd.​
Samut Prakan, Thailand​
May 2017 – May 2019
●​ Assisted senior technicians with preventive maintenance of food-processing and
packaging equipment.
●​ Inspected motors, pumps, bearings, chains, and pneumatic lines.
●​ Replaced damaged mechanical components under supervision.
●​ Maintained workshop tools and spare-parts storage areas.
●​ Completed basic maintenance checklists and equipment inspection records.
●​ Followed hygiene and safety requirements for food-production areas.
